about: Streets of the old city that keep their historic lines, from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). from: the earliest era each is drawn in; half: half its width in metres. Also every minor street, lane, alley, footway and set of steps mapped today in the old town, Redcliffe and Temple (main roads known to be later left out): today's routes are assumed to follow older ones, so they are kept walkable.
